help.noFaqFoundSub: Try searching with different keywords or contact our 24/7 support below.
help.faq1q: What is F2C App and how does it work?
help.faq1a: F2C stands for 'Farm to Consumer'. It connects you directly with verified local farmers to purchase fresh produce. With zero middlemen, customers enjoy 10-30% lower prices and farmers earn fair, dignified profits!
help.faq2a: Browse crops on the home screen, select your desired quantity, and tap 'Add to Cart'. Review your items in the Cart, tap 'Checkout', enter your complete delivery address, and confirm your order.
help.faq3q: Can I cancel my order? What is the cancellation window?
help.faq3a: Yes! You can cancel your order within 180 minutes (3 hours) of placing it directly from the 'Orders' screen. Cancellations cannot be accepted after this window as farmers begin harvesting, sorting, and packaging your produce.
help.faq4q: When will I get my refund after order cancellation?
help.faq4a: Refunds are processed and credited within 24 hours of cancellation approval. The refund will be credited back to your original payment method or UPI account.
help.faq5q: Can I place bulk or wholesale orders?
help.faq5a: Yes! Restaurants, hotels, caterers, grocery stores, and hostels can place bulk wholesale orders directly with farmers at exclusive farm-gate rates.
help.faq6a: Typically delivered within 24 hours of harvest to preserve maximum freshness, crunch, and nutritional value. Exact delivery schedules are indicated on each product page.
help.faq7a: Yes! Select local farmers in your vicinity offer same-day express delivery. This is clearly highlighted with a 'Same-Day Delivery' tag on the product details page.
help.faq8q: What should I do if my delivery is delayed?
help.faq8a: You can track the live status under the 'Orders' section in the app. If your order is delayed by more than 24 hours due to transit issues, please reach out to our support team immediately.
help.faq9a: Delivery is 100% free for the first 3 months for all users! Afterwards, a nominal fee of ₹20-₹40 may apply depending on distance. Group Buy and bulk orders always enjoy 100% free delivery.
help.faq10q: Can I live-track the Delivery Partner on the map?
help.faq10a: Yes! Once your produce is picked up from the farm, you can track the delivery partner's real-time GPS location directly on Google Maps inside the app.
help.faq11q: Can I add multiple delivery addresses? Why is a complete address required?
help.faq11a: Currently, you should maintain your verified primary home address. Entering complete details (door number, street name, area, district, and 6-digit PIN code) ensures our delivery partners reach your doorstep without delay.
help.faq12a: Yes! By eliminating wholesale commission agents, transport markups, and cold-storage expenses, F2C offers farm-fresh vegetables and fruits at 10% to 30% lower prices than supermarkets.
help.faq13q: What payment methods are supported? Is online payment available?
help.faq13a: Currently, Cash on Delivery (COD) is available. Online payment options including UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, and Credit/Debit cards will be introduced very soon.
help.faq14q: Will I get a full refund or partial refund for damaged items?
help.faq14a: Depending on the condition and severity of the issue, we provide either a partial or 100% full refund. For spoiled or incorrect items, a full 100% refund is processed immediately.
help.faq15q: How can I trust that produce is fresh?
help.faq15a: Every product displays the exact harvest date and time, verified farmer profile, audit badges, and our real-time Freshness Tracker clock showing elapsed hours since harvest.
help.faq16q: How does the Freshness Tracker work?
help.faq16a: The Freshness Tracker calculates and displays the exact time elapsed since the farmer harvested the crop. 0-40% shows 'Very Fresh', and 40-70% shows 'Still Good', giving you transparent freshness data.
help.faq17a: The Harvest Calendar shows upcoming harvesting dates planned by farmers for the next 7-14 days. You can plan your household needs and pre-order fresh harvests in advance.
help.faq18q: Do I need to upload photos when raising a complaint?
help.faq18a: Yes! Uploading clear photos of any damaged or substandard produce acts as verified proof, enabling our team to approve immediate refunds without disputes.
help.faq19q: How can I identify 100% organic and natural produce?
help.faq19a: Produce grown without synthetic fertilizers or chemical pesticides carries an 'Organic / Natural' badge. You can view the organic fertilizers and natural farming methods on the farmer's profile.
help.faq20q: How does the Nutrition Report benefit my family?
help.faq20a: The Nutrition Report analyzes your weekly orders to show your family's intake of essential vitamins (A, C, K), iron, minerals, and antioxidants, helping you maintain a healthy, balanced diet.
help.faq21q: What is Pre-Ordering and what are the benefits?
help.faq21a: Pre-ordering allows you to reserve crops before harvest. You get the freshest produce harvested on day one and enjoy an exclusive 15% to 28% discount!
help.faq22q: What happens if a pre-ordered crop harvest is delayed?
help.faq22a: If unexpected weather or rainfall delays harvest, you will receive real-time notifications with the revised date. You can choose to wait for the new date or cancel with an instant 100% refund.
help.faq23q: What is Group Buy and how does 5-member pooling work?
help.faq23a: Group Buy lets you pool orders with 5 or more neighbors, colleagues, or apartment residents to a single delivery location. Everyone gets a 15-25% community discount and 100% free delivery!
help.faq24q: What happens if a Group Buy doesn't reach 5 members?
help.faq24a: If the group does not reach 5 members before the deadline expires, the order is canceled automatically with an instant 100% refund, or you can convert it to a regular individual order.
help.faq25q: Is my personal data safe and protected?
help.faq25a: 100% secure! All user details, phone numbers, addresses, and chat records are encrypted and hosted securely on Google Firebase cloud with zero third-party sharing.
help.faq26q: What does the 'Verified Farmer' badge mean?
help.faq26a: The F2C agricultural field team physically visits and audits the farm, inspecting soil health, irrigation water purity, and cultivation ethics before granting the 'Verified Farmer' badge.
help.faq27q: What details can I check by scanning the Farmer QR code?
help.faq27a: Scanning the QR code on your delivery package shows the farmer's verified identity, farm GPS location, harvest date, and official audit inspection report directly on your phone.
help.faq28q: What can I ask a farmer via direct in-app chat?
help.faq28a: You can chat directly with the farmer about farming techniques, organic manure, crop varieties, best storage practices, or request customized harvest bundles.
help.faq29q: How does the AI Assistant assist in Farmer Chat?
help.faq29a: When farmers are busy tending their fields, our intelligent AI Assistant provides immediate, accurate answers to common crop, nutrition, storage, and cooking queries.
help.faq30q: What are Farmer Reels & Stories for?
help.faq30a: Farmers upload authentic short field videos showing their crops, natural farming practices, and live harvesting. You can see with your own eyes where and how your food is grown.
help.faq31q: How to book and experience a Farm Visit with family?
help.faq31a: Select 'Farm Visit' in the app, choose a participating local farm, and reserve a weekend slot to experience farm life, fruit picking, and nature with your children and family.
help.faq32q: How can a local farmer register and sell harvests on F2C?
help.faq32a: Farmers can sign up under the 'Farmer' role, submit farm and harvest details, complete the field verification audit, and start selling directly to consumers with zero commission fees!
help.faq33q: How do I contact F2C Customer Support?
help.faq33a: You can connect instantly with our support team via WhatsApp (+91 9360425423 / +91 9585475247), phone call, or email at f2cnow@gmail.com directly from the Help screen.
help.faq34q: What are Customer Support working hours?
help.faq34a: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Urgent delivery and transit queries are prioritized.
help.faq35q: Where can I share my feedback or suggestions to improve F2C?
help.faq35a: Navigate to Settings > 'Give Feedback' to submit your suggestions and experience. We review every user feedback to continually improve F2C!
